User Journey: Automotive Foundation - Vehicle Lifecycle 360 Journey (Account → Contact → Vehicle → Asset → Warranty → Milestone → Service Territory)
Business Process:
1. Dealer Sales Executive captures a customer (Person Account or Business Account + Contact) and ties them to a Vehicle/Asset record at sale.
2. System creates Asset (Vehicle RT) keyed to the Vehicle (VIN), links Account as owner via AssetAccountParticipant, links Contacts as drivers via AssetContactParticipant.
3. AssetWarranty is auto-generated from the Vehicle Product2 master warranty terms; AssetMilestone records are scheduled (first service, inspection, warranty expiry).
4. AssetRelationship is created for any tow vehicle/trailer or removable battery pairing.
5. Service Advisor uses ServiceTerritory + ServiceTerritoryMember + OperatingHours + TimeSlot to schedule first service appointment and surface upcoming milestones.
6. Customer support flow uses InfoAuthRequestForm + InfoAuthorizationRequest to verify identity before sharing PII; MultipartyInfoAuthRequest used for joint owners.
7. AssetDowntimePeriod logged when vehicle in service or recall.
8. Audit Trail + Telemetry capture every transition.

User Journey: Automotive Foundation - Trade-in / Appraisal Initiation Journey (Lead/Opportunity → Appraisal → AppraisalItem → ProviderValuation → Adjustment → AddOn)
Business Process:
1. Dealer Sales Executive captures customer trade-in interest from Lead, Opportunity, Account, Vehicle Console, or Asset Console.
2. Sales Executive launches Appraisal flow (Vehicle or Asset variant) — populates Appraisal record with Interest Type (Trade-in / Valuation / Sale).
3. System creates AppraisalItem record for the vehicle/asset being appraised; auto-populates Make/Model/Year/Trim/VIN/Mileage from Vehicle/Asset linkage.
4. Sales Executive captures vehicle condition, features, accessories — creates AppraisalItemAddOn rows for each accessory selected.
5. System fans out to external valuation providers — creates AppraisalItemProviderValuation row per provider per item (KBB, JD Power, Black Book, Manheim).
6. Sales Executive negotiates with customer — creates AppraisalAdjustment rows for Markup, Discount, Reconditioning Cost, Dents.
7. Final Appraisal Price calculated = Initial Price + sum(Adjustment Price); routed for Finance Manager approval.
8. On approval, system creates QuoteLineItemRelatedObject linking the appraised vehicle to the customer's Quote (Trade-in line).

User Journey: Automotive Foundation - Service Operations Journey (ServiceTerritory + Member + Location + WorkType + OperatingHours + Vehicle Downtime + Recall)
Business Process:
1. Service Advisor receives request (customer or telemetry-driven) for service appointment, recall, or roadside assistance.
2. System queries ServiceTerritory + ServiceTerritoryLocation + ServiceTerritoryWorkType + ServiceTerritoryMember to find available Field Resource matching the work type and location.
3. OperatingHours + OperatingHoursHoliday + TimeSlot validate that the proposed appointment lands on a working slot.
4. AssetDowntimePeriod created when vehicle goes into service or is on recall.
5. AssetMilestone for upcoming service / inspection / warranty expiry surface in the Service Console.
6. Identity Verification (InfoAuthRequestForm + InfoAuthorizationRequest) required before sharing service history if the requester is not the registered owner.
